cast.originalCharacterName: ユリス＝アレクシア・マリー・フロレンツィア・レナーテ・フォン・リースフェルト

segments.text: Julis is fifth ranking student of Seidoukan Academy, also known as "Glühen Rose", and is the First Princess of Lieseltania, a small country located in western Czech Republic. Julis is elegant, proud, beautiful, hot-headed, stubborn, and can be cold to those she is unfamiliar with. However, underneath that cold, unfriendly facade, is an honorable, faithful, and loyal person who would do just about anything for a friend. Initially, she treats Ayato and his friends with (mostly) disdain, but eventually warms up to them and even calls them by their name. Julis has a fear of disappointment and rejection, and will do whatever it takes to keep her friends safe. She dislikes relying on others.

She wields a rapier-type lux called "Aspera Spina" which she uses during the Phoenix tournament and bears the image of a flower for her power - control over flames. Julis's main objective behind entering Seidoukan Academy is to obtain money for an orphanage in Lieseltania.
Edited from Wikipedia & Asterisk War Wiki

Saya is Ayato's childhood friend and the daughter of Soichi and Kaya Sasamiya. She moved abroad six years ago to Munich due to her father's career and lost contact with Ayato. Saya is a drowsy-seeming girl, but is much more sharp and intelligent than she initially appears. However, she has bad sense of direction and is very bad with mornings.

She uses all kinds of weapons her inventor father has created for her - for example, a 38th generation Lux grenade launcher Helnekrom, a type 41 Gleaming Form - twin particle guns Waidenholt and Type 34 wave Motion heavy artillery Ark Van Ders. She entered the Festa in order to promote her father's weapons.
Edited from Wikipedia & Asterisk War Wiki

Kirin is one of Saya's best friends. Kirin is generally shy, sweet, and polite. Due to her childhood trauma of indirectly causing her father to be incarcerated, she is initially self-loathing. After being inspired by Ayato to be her own person instead of someone else's tool, she begins to be more assertive, although she is still full of self-doubt and as such, she reguarly apologizes profusely whenever she finds herself to have offended others in any way, even when it is not entirely her fault. As she is used to being treated as a tool instead of a person, she is slow to warm up to others, but in time has proven herself to be a good friend.

Being the only child of the Toudou family, Kirin is very proficient and extensively trained in her family's style, the Toudouryuu, which is a type of martial arts. The essence of it is to fool the opponent through the use of gaze, breathing, and slight movements. The Toudouryuu has 49 techniques that can be chained together to create fluid attacks. She wields a katana called "Senbakiri" as her weapon and her reason for entering the Festa is to release her father from jail.
Edited from Wikipedia & Asterisk War Wiki

cast.originalCharacterName: クローディア・エンフィールド

segments.text: Claudia is the second top-ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and its Student Council President. She recommends Ayato's transfer to the academy. Claudia is refined, friendly, and intelligent. As Student Council President, she oversees most of the school's affairs herself, and is always well informed about the going-ons in both her own school and the other schools. When with Ayato, she displays a sly and coy side, frequently teasing the hapless Ayato. When alone with him, however, she shows a weak, delicate, and vulnerable nature. Claudia states herself as "usually quite pure/well-behaved" but also "scheming", and Ayato states her ways as "not quite ruthless".

She wields the Pan-Dora, an Ogre Lux which allows her to see into the future during duels, hence she is known as "Master of Thousand Eyes". However, her weapon has a serious side effect: she is foced to have nightmares of her dying in all kinds of different ways every night. She wants to win the Gryps Festa in order to make her wish come true, which remains unknown.
Edited from Wikipedia & Asterisk War Wiki

segments.text: Sylvia is the world's top idol, the Student Council President and the top student of Queenvail Girls' Academy who is very persistent. Sylvia was the previous runner up of the last Lindvolus, after losing to Orphelia, which makes her the second strongest person in Asterisk. She is a bright and energetic girl who gets along with everyone. She is playful around Ayato but understands how important her public appearance is.
Sylvia is looking for her master, Ursula Svento, who taught her about music and the world who might also have participated in the Eclipse just like Ayato's sister.
Edited from Wikipedia & Asterisk War Wiki

segments.text: Irene is a student at Rewolf Black Institute and the older sister of Priscilla. She and her sister are from a war-torn country, and got saved by the student council president of Rewolf Black Institute, Dirk Eberwein, as an exchange for Irene becoming Gravisheath's owner. Irene is harsh, cynical, rude, and violent, which could be partially attributed to their harsh upbringing. As such, she irritates, and makes enemies easily out of, just about anyone around her. Priscilla seems to be the only one capable of telling her off, even capable of making her apologize to others for her misdeeds.
Irene wields the Ogre Lux Gravisheath, which enables her to control gravity within a set area and create gravity orbs at the cost of her blood.

segments.text: Priscilla is a student at Rewolf Black Institute and the younger sister of Irene. She and her sister are from a war-torn country, and got saved by the student council president of Rewolf Black Institute, Dirk Eberwein, as an exchange for Irene becoming Gravisheath's owner. Priscilla is kind hearted and watchful over her sister and even those she has just met.

Priscilla is a rare regenerative type Strega that is able to heal herself over time by regenerating anything lost. While she can regenerate, if something like her blood is taken in large quantities over a short period of time, she can still die.

segments.text: Ernesta is a student at Arlequint Academy, the school of technology, and the head of the Pygmalion Faction. Ernesta is shown to be peppy intellectual who enjoys a challenge, has a dark sense of humor, and is quite manipulative. She likes toying with her opponents as well as with her research subjects, giving them handicap without hesitating just for the fun of it.
Flora is an orphan from Lieseltania and a Genestellar who works for the orphanage Julis wants to donate the prize money to.

Madiath is a member of the Integrated Enterprise Foundation in charge of the Festa. Madiath is a calm and cunning person, able to plan ahead in case something happens, and is able to stay calm in situations where others get worried or angry.

segments.text: Lester is a student at Seidoukan Academy. Lester is very aggressive since he believes that pure raw strength is all that needs to use to win a fight. He has a high temperament and a violent atmosphere around him, and is also very competitive.
Lester wields the Axe Lux Bardiche-Leo, which is a large axe, almost as large as Lester himself.
One of Lester's lackeys.

Shenhua is a student at Jie Long Seventh Institute and Shenyun's twin sister. Shenhua is arrogant, shrewd, sadistic and treats her opponents as toys rather than people. In battle, she prefers to set up situations favorable for herself and Shenyun, making themselves untouchable while hounding on their opponents' weaknesses. They never beat their opponents easily even though they are able to do so, preferring to see their opponents struggle and despair. They are deemed to be despicable enough for Hufeng to expressed his disgust of them, noting that "no one could ever get along with them".
Shenhua also tends to fall in love with people easily and according to Shenyun she doesn't have a good eye for men, forcing him to protect her from unworthy potential boyfriends.

Shenyun is a student at Jie Long Seventh Institute and Shenhua's twin brother. Shenyun is arrogant, shrewd, sadistic and he treats his opponents as toys rather than people. In battle, he prefers to set up situations favorable for himself and Shenhua, making themselves untouchable while hounding on their opponents' weaknesses. They never beat their opponents easily even though they are able to do so, preferring to see their opponents struggle and despair. They are deemed to be despicable enough for Hufeng to expressed his disgust of them, noting that "no one could ever get along with them".

Shenyun is also somewhat of a siscon, worrying about Shenhua whenever he realizes that she has a potential boyfriend, and always stalks her on her dates to see what type of man she's with. If he deems them as unworthy, he gets rid of them in a roundabout manner by indirectly showing their faults to his sister, though he will take action himself if it comes down to it.

A student of Arlequint Academy and one of Ernesta's friends. Camilla more serious than her friend and steadfast in her views. She is also very intelligent. Camilla believes that weapons should be made able to use by anyone due to the weapons of the bodyguards not working when her parents were killed.
